survey: A cartoon gravestone seen from slightly above and to the front-right. Main parts: (1) An upright slab with a rounded top and a broken, stepped notch at the upper right. The front face is turned only a little away from the camera, and its right-side thickness shows as a narrow band down the right edge. The thickness of the arch shows along its top right, and the broken step shows its flat top surfaces. (2) A cross in raised relief on the front face. It lies flat on that face, and its thickness shows on the same side as the slab's. (3) A long, low base block. Its top, front and right end are all visible, so it is seen from the same high front-right view. Its front edge drops slightly toward the right, as it should with the right end nearer the camera. (4) The slab is set back from the base's front edge and sits flat on the base top. Its bottom edge runs roughly parallel to the base's front edge. (5) Moss clumps and a flower lie on the slab and on the base top, and they follow those surfaces. (6) A soft shadow under the base meets the floor plane. The slab's verticals stay vertical, and all the receding edges agree on one camera.
